info.name: MyCondo API
info.description: Manual testing collection for MyCondo. Run the four logins in folder 1 first, then use the role folders.

item.name: 1. Login (run these first)
item.description: Run all four once. Each saves its token into a collection variable, and the role folders below use them automatically.

request.description: In the Body tab, click Select Files on the proof row and choose an image or PDF.
Creates a real bill in the Billplz sandbox. Open payment_url in a browser to see the payment page.
Tick the photo row and choose an image if you want to attach one.
Newest first, 15 per page. Saves the first notification id into {{notification_id}} for the next requests.

exec: pm.test("Every item is unread", () => pm.response.json().data.forEach(n => pm.expect(n.read_at).to.eql(null)));

request.description: Use this for the bell badge.
Run "List my notifications" first so {{notification_id}} is set.

item.name: Add a resident to a unit

request.description: The committee has its own inbox. It only sees notifications sent to the committee user.

item.name: Try to read a resident's notification (expect 404)

request.description: Uses the committee token with the id saved from the resident folder. Must be 404.

exec: pm.test("Another user's notification is not found", () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));

request.description: Uses the committee token. Only admin can manage users.
Generates a fresh email each run, saves the new id into {{user_id}}. Only committee and security can be created here.

item.name: Log in as the new staff account

request.description: Run right after creating the account: 200. Run again after Deactivate: 403 "Your account is not active". After Reset password, the old password gives 422.
Also deletes the user's tokens, so open sessions stop working immediately.
Replaces the password and ends the user's sessions. Log in with "brand-new-pass" afterwards.
Run "Who am I?" first so {{admin_id}} is set.

exec: pm.test("An admin cannot deactivate themselves", () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));

item.name: 5. Security
item.description: Register a visitor as the resident first. The pass code is saved automatically.

item.name: 6. Billplz callback simulator

request.description: Run Resident > Pay online with Billplz first. This plays Billplz calling our webhook with a valid signature.
